 4 1/2" x 5 1/4", quarter page ad. New Jersey: Paillard Incorporated (1969). 
 A small (quarter page) ad for the Bolex 155 Macrozoom Super 8 camera. This ad mentions two things I've never come across, but hope to (or at least hope to find someone who has). 1) A Bolex demonstration film for the 155. 2) A 32-page color book on the 155. If you have either of these items, or know more about them, I'd love to hear about it.
